description: Pre-emit AI-vernacular self-check an agent runs on its OWN prose before writing a session-log narrative, ADR context section, retrospective, or PR description. Four layers ordered by reader-trust, not ease of detection. Use when you say `prose self-check`, `audit my writing for AI tells`, `does this read as AI-written`, or before emitting any prose artifact. Do NOT use for code style (use style-enforcement) or to rewrite human-authored text.
